title: ID0442061-DC/SI-D/FR-[Y2 / PD 312571675/25] LED turns red at the end of each attempt
description:
Reported issue:
It’s not possible to start a charge on the connectors of the charger.
The charging steps never validate, even after several attempts. The
charging point LED turns red at the end of each attempt.
I tried to charge unsuccessfully on the connectors on 05/08/2025
at 11:55 AM and 12:08 PM (French time).
Could you please perform a diagnostic and intervene if necessary?
Solution: NA

Hello Maxime, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
I checked the charging sessions from that date and it seems that the EV is not sending the communication protocol to start the Authentication.
Every time that there is a session with this EV it doesn't send the messages necessary to start:
This is the message that fails to be sent:
I checked and there are multiple sessions in either DC1 and DC2 from this week:
DC1
DC2
I restarted the SECCs without rebooting the charger. Please try again and let me know if it still fails.
What kind of EV brand and model is it? It might be that there is some sort of incompatibility.
I installed a new update on the SECC to be able to get a specific set of logs in case we would need to talk with the EV brand.
Let me know once you are able to redo the sessions
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0442061-DC/SI-D/FR-[Y2 / PD 312571675/25] LED turns red at the end of each attempt CRM:02678000169
additional_info.body:
Hello Francisco,
I’m surprised that the issue is being linked to the vehicle model, as I’ve been charging exclusively on Sicharge D units since I got this car (Tesla Model 3).
Could this issue possibly be related to the new v7 update?
Are there any new checks now being performed on vehicles before a charging session can start?
We’re also seeing charging session start errors with all types of vehicles on our customer on sites.
